newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO police return border position to Israel.
newsitem.headline: PLO police return border position to Israel.

text.p: Palestinian police handed back a border position between Gaza and Egypt to the Israeli army on Saturday, one day after it was seized in a gun battle, witnesses said.

An Israeli colonel was killed and four soldiers wounded when Palestinian policemen and demonstrators overran the position near the Gaza Strip town of Rafah on Friday and hoisted a Palestinian flag over it.
"An Israeli flag had been raised on the position again and now there are three armoured personnel carriers standing near it," one witness said.

The Egyptian official news agency MENA had reported that Palestinians seized a border checkpoint on Saturday after soldiers stationed there fled the area. But witnesses said the incident took place on Friday.
Israeli attack helicopters tried all day on Friday to take back the position without success.
Under an interim peace deal that established Palestinian autonomy in parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip, Israel remained in control of the borders of the self-rule areas.

Palestinians and Israelis fought three days of gun battles this week after Israel opened an archaeological tunnel in Arab East Jerusalem which Palestinians fear threatens Islam's third holiest shrine.
The Israeli army spokesman denied a MENA report which said Israeli soldiers, along with Palestinian police, had been taken captive by Egyptian police during the fighting.
"Israeli army soldiers were not arrested by Egyptian police," an army spokesman said.
